brief:
Israeli forces abducted more than twenty Palestinian citizens across the West Bank on Monday, IMEMC News reported. The detentions spanned seven governorates: Tulkarem, Qalqilia, Nablus, Jenin, Ramallah, Bethlehem, and Hebron. Among those taken into custody was Diaa Ali Muhammad, according to media sources tracking the operations.

The mass abduction marked the latest in a series of arrest sweeps conducted by occupation forces in Palestinian territories. Such operations have occurred with frequency across multiple West Bank districts, affecting civilians in both urban and rural areas throughout the region.

title: Israeli forces abduct more than twenty Palestinians across West Bank
